graph_bin.layout: CSR little-endian: int32 indptr (n+1), int32 indices (n_edges), float32 signed weights (n_edges)
graph_bin.note: indices are positions into bodyId. signed weight = synapse_count * NT_sign(pre).

filter_definitions.proboscis_gustatory: class == "gustatory" AND subclass in {"labellar bristle", "taste peg", "pharyngeal sensillum"}

bfs.keep: intersection of both searches, plus seed sets

control_partners.reason: preserve neurons that may provide inhibitory control onto the core set

cap.policy: drop weakest-connected first; never drop a seed

path_sign_deprecated.test: validate_per.ts (2026-09-16): path_sign=-1 at 100 Hz drove MN9 at 52 Hz vs 32 Hz for all labellar. Product-of-signs on one strongest path is not net effect.

drive_measurement.role_rule: terciles of deltaMn9Hz over all 271 proboscis gustatory seeds (rank 1 = strongest MN9 drive)
